title: Evidence ledger row
description: One atomic fact recovered from one place in one material file. The locator is the point of the row: a row a reviewer cannot re-open is not evidence. `scripts/scan_case.py` writes rows in this shape; a row added by hand must satisfy it too.

eid.description: Stable identifier, cited in the draft as [E0001]. Assigned in extraction order, so a re-scan of unchanged inputs reproduces it.

kind.description: Where the fact came from, in terms of how far it can be trusted: config_value is the configured default, log_value is what a run recorded, paper_statement is prose.

name.description: The key as it appears in the source, not a normalised name: `train.learning_rate`, `--batch-size`, `split_seed`.

value.description: The value as extracted. Keep the source's own type where possible (number, boolean, string). A string that carries a unit, such as `4h27m`, is acceptable.

display.description: How the value is written in prose and in the parameter table.

unit.description: `1` for dimensionless, `name` for a symbol-valued setting, otherwise the unit: `samples`, `epochs`, `steps`, `GB`, `runs`, `ratio`, `version`.

applies_to.description: What the value acts on: optimiser, dataloader, model, training loop, learning-rate schedule. Not where it was found.

source_file.description: Path relative to the case input root.

source_locator.description: Re-openable pointer. Text or log: `<path>:<line>` (1-based). JSON/YAML/TOML: `<path>#/<json-pointer>`.

method.description: The extraction rule that produced the row: `yaml`, `toml`, `argparse_default`, `module_constant`, `seed_call`, `log_kv`, `version_line`, `split_count_line`, `baseline_line`, `prose_sentence`, `raw_line`. Lets a reviewer tell a parsed value from a guessed one.

confidence.description: high = parsed out of a structured file; medium = log line or heuristic key match; low = prose sentence, usable for wording only and never as a number.

status.description: conflict means another source records a different value for the same parameter. Both rows keep status conflict and neither is resolved by the skill.

note.description: Free text: the other side of a conflict, or why a row was kept despite low confidence.

cited_in_draft.description: Set by the audit when the eid appears in the draft.
